title: CYBRIK common definitions v1
description: Shared vendor-neutral primitives referenced by the CYBRIK cross-product contract packet. $id uses the RFC 2606 reserved .example documentation domain; it is a stable identifier, NOT an operational endpoint. Status: PROPOSED — NOT ACCEPTED.

sha256Digest.description: Content digest as 'sha256:' followed by 64 lowercase hex chars.

tenantId.description: Opaque authoritative tenant identifier. The value carried in any payload is advisory only; the receiving service derives the authoritative tenant from the caller credential and MUST reject on mismatch (ADR-0006 E1; strategy 05 §3).

timestampUtc.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC (trailing Z).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value.

tracestate.description: W3C Trace Context tracestate header value.

riskClass.description: Untrusted-input risk class (ADR-0004 F3). R0 read-metadata … R3 highest-risk side effect.

isolationProfile.description: Executor isolation profile (ADR-0004 F3). S0 pooled long-lived (R0 only, policy-permitting); S1–S3 disposable per-invocation.

actor.description: Who/what is acting. For type=user, `id` is the SOC-owned tenant membership id (authoritative analyst identity remains SOC-owned; ADR-0006). For type=service/agent, `id` is a workload identity (SPIFFE-style; ADR-0006 E2). Written only by authenticated service code; model output can never populate it.

id.description: Opaque actor id. user → SOC membership id; service/agent → workload identity (e.g. spiffe://…).

delegated_by.description: Optional id of the actor that delegated authority to this actor. Full authorization is the digest-bound delegation chain, not this hint.

objectRef.description: Vendor-neutral reference to a product-owned object (e.g. a SOC alert or case). The object is opaque to the contract; it is dereferenced through the owner's authorized API, never a public URL (strategy 05 §4.5).

version.description: Owner-supplied revision/etag of the referenced object at reference time.

locator.description: Opaque owner-issued locator (e.g. cybrik://…). MUST NOT be an arbitrary public URL.
